title: Implement catalog_preview_cache component
description:
Implement catalog_preview_cache.py for project catalog-api using the README.md component API. Export the complete approved nested POLICY with exact keys and types, the exact SOURCE and RATIONALE, and a working create_cache(clock) returning a ResponseCache governed by that policy.

Use the current standing agreement stored under Beads key catalog-api.response-cache. Fully recall it with bd recall 'catalog-api.response-cache' before implementing. This reference was verified after trial-03x retained Operations approval CACHE-18 (2026-09-06), version v2: TTL 300 seconds; max_entries 3; eviction_policy "fifo"; namespace "catalog-response"; cache_misses true; project "catalog-api". The current agreement applies because preview is another catalog-api response-cache reader covered by the shared standing agreement. This task uses the current agreement, not a historical replay.

Depends on trial-03x, which implemented catalog_refresh_cache.py and permanently revised and verified the durable standing agreement to CACHE-18 v2. Preserve earlier components, files, and task history. The original CACHE-17 v1 approval is retained separately for audit replay; do not apply that historical policy to this current reader.

Verify TTL boundary behavior, cached None results, FIFO capacity without read reordering, expiry freeing capacity, namespaced live keys, and independent cache instances. Add relevant component tests and run python3 -m unittest discover -s tests. Do not alter the standing agreement merely to reproduce it.
